final_output:
Confirm and send international wire to IBAN GB29 NWBO
IBAN stands for International Bank Account Number. It is a standard format for identifying bank accounts across borders. The first two letters represent the country code for Ireland, "GB" in this case. The next eight digits are the account number of the account holder at First Federal Bank. The final letter is usually a check digit used to validate the IBAN.
